description: This file is a Perl script for flashing firmware onto a D-Link DSL-502T router, specifically handling detection, validation, and flashing of firmware images, along with interacting with the device's bootloader via FTP and network sockets.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with custom methods for interacting with the ADAM2 bootloader, including environment variable retrieval, reboot, and command execution.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Overrides the USER command to send uppercase commands required by ADAM2.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables from the device via FTP commands.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get environment variables.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends reboot command to the device.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot the device and close the connection.
